name: CostMeter
summary: Spend against a ceiling, with the soft and hard limits kept apart.

a11y.apg: meter — spend inside a known range. aria-valuenow is clamped to the limit because a value outside the range is invalid in ARIA; the true spend, which may have overshot, is carried by aria-valuetext.

props.name: spent
props.description: Amount spent in the period. Costs below one cent are printed with up to six decimals: two fixed decimals, which is what the reference formatter uses, would print "$0.00" for a real spend of $0.004 and blank out the number in the very component built to watch it.

props.name: limit
props.description: The hard ceiling — the one that blocks. Without it there is no meter and no bar, only the amount. Measured from LiteLLM, the 2026 market standard for LLM cost control.

props.name: softLimit
props.description: The threshold that only warns. Absent, there is no warning state: deriving one at 80% of the limit would be an invented number, and an alert firing at a threshold nobody configured is noise wearing the clothes of a policy. Crossing it does NOT repaint the bar — measured: in the dark theme --warning-400 IS the brand yellow, the same value as --primary, so a warning bar would be indistinguishable from a normal one. The soft limit speaks in words, through the Alert; colour is kept for the hard limit, where red separates in both themes.

props.name: segments
props.description: Optional breakdown of the amount — input, output, cache — rendered as a DataList.

props.name: period
props.description: What the amount refers to, shown beside it: "This month", "Last 24h".

props.name: locale
props.description: Passed to Intl.NumberFormat. Fixed by default for the same reason as in ModelUsage: deterministic output across machines.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the region and of the meter.
